blocks.text: Buying an Apartment Condo in Maple Ridge: Town Centre & Port Haney

parts.t: Apartment condos in Maple Ridge are concentrated in the walkable urban core of East Central (where apartments represent 52.7% of all housing units) and neighbouring West Central. Residents enjoy flat walking access to Haney Place Mall, ValleyFair Mall, the Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, THE ACT Arts Centre, Memorial Peace Park, and Port Haney West Coast Express Station.

In the Q3 2026 MLS® snapshot, East Central condos had a median list price of $539,000 ($638/sq ft), offering first-time buyers, commuters, and downsizers one of the most attainable entry points in Metro Vancouver—backed by Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 and the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condo Strata Due Diligence: Form B, Depreciation & Insurance

parts.t: Before removing conditions on any Maple Ridge condo, we review two full years of strata council and AGM/SGM minutes, the Form B Information Certificate (confirming monthly strata maintenance fees, Contingency Reserve Fund balances, underground parking and storage locker designations, and any special levies), the building envelope Depreciation Report, and the strata water-damage insurance deductible.

What is the typical price of a condo in Maple Ridge?

In the Q3 2026 MLS® snapshot, the median list price for an apartment condo in East Central Maple Ridge was $539,000 ($638 per sq ft), with 1-bedroom units typically starting in the upper $300,000s to mid-$400,000s and newer 2-bedroom units ranging from $525,000 to $750,000.

Are there 55+ age-restricted condo buildings in Maple Ridge?
Yes. Maple Ridge has several 55+ adult-oriented apartment buildings in Town Centre (East Central) and West Central near medical clinics and shopping; browse active listings on our
What does the Form B Information Certificate tell a condo buyer?

The Form B Information Certificate is a mandatory legal document from the strata corporation disclosing the unit's monthly strata fee, any amount owed by the current owner, the strata's Contingency Reserve Fund (CRF) balance, approved special levies, and how parking stalls and storage lockers are designated.
Can I rent out a condo in Maple Ridge?

Yes. Under British Columbia's Strata Property Act, strata corporations cannot enforce general long-term rental bans (except in 55+ age-restricted buildings where occupants must meet the age bylaw), though most stratas prohibit short-term vacation rentals.
